2. Smart file sorting  
   • As soon as new files land in a watch folder (from email, downloads, or network share), sort them into a clear folder tree that separates Documents from Media (images & videos) and further sub-organises by date or naming convention we agree on.

title: Predictive modelling for classification
desc:

Deliverables
• Clean, commented source code and environment file  
• Trained model artefact (pickled or equivalent)  
• Evaluation report with the metrics above and confusion matrix visuals  
• Short Markdown or Jupyter notebook highlighting feature importance and usage instructions  

If you can optionally add a lightweight REST endpoint (FastAPI or Flask) for real-time predictions, let me know—the extra polish would be appreciated.

title: A COMPARATIVE LEGAL ANALYSIS OF INDIA’S GOODS AND SERVICES TAX (GST) AND NEPAL’S VALUE ADDED TAX (VAT) SYSTEM: IMPLICATIONS FOR CROSS-BORDER TRADE AND TAX POLICY REFORM

5. Delivered in Word and PDF, with all underlying datasets

I am looking for someone who has built tests from scratch, run item analyses in software such as SPSS/R, and can communicate psychometric concepts in plain language. desc:
I already have a detailed 2D floor plan in DWG/PDF and now need it translated into engaging, photorealistic 3D visuals. The brief covers full-fledged interior renders for the Living room, Bedroom and Kitchen, all executed in a crisp Modern style.

Focus inside each room is on:  
• Seating arrangements that feel inviting and functional  
• Clever, built-in storage solutions  
• Statement lighting fixtures that anchor the design  

Workflow and deliverables  
• I will provide the floor plan with exact dimensions, material notes and mood references.  
• You will return:  
 
  – A minimum of three high-resolution interior angles per requested room  
  – Native model files (SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit or similar) plus FBX/OBJ exports 

The total area is modest, so every square foot must work hard. Clean modelling, realistic PBR materials and balanced lighting are expected; V-Ray, Corona, Lumion or Blender’s Cycles all work for me.

Please include a link to comparable modern interiors you have produced and an estimated turnaround time—work can begin as soon as the portfolio fits.

title: Cartoon-Style 2D Animation
desc:
I have a complete script in hand and now need it brought to life as a lively, engaging 2D cartoon animation. The goal is a polished video that matches the playful tone of the script while keeping pacing tight and visuals clean. 

Here’s what I will supply:
• Final script in PDF.  
• Basic notes on colour palette, mood, and any must-show moments.  

What I’m looking for from you:
• Character and background design that feel cohesive with the story.  
• Full animation production—storyboard (if you’d like to rough one out before animating), clean-ups, colouring, compositing, and final rendering in HD.  
• Simple sound design and music placement, using royalty-free tracks or anything you already own the rights to.  
• One round of revisions after the first full draft so we can fine-tune timing and expressions.  

Please mention the software you’re most comfortable with (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, TVPaint, etc.) and include links to a few cartoon pieces you’ve completed recently. If everything lines up, we can get started right away and discuss milestones for storyboard approval and final delivery.

title: Site Surveyor (DME,BE,ITI ,TECHEE) Needs
desc:
I need a web-based surveyor site focused solely on reporting and analysis. The platform should let me pull data from three distinct sources—database exports, real-time API feeds, and the occasional uploaded file—then present that information as clean, detailed tabular reports that can be filtered, sorted, and exported (CSV and Excel at minimum).

A straightforward dashboard is enough; no complex charting is required. What matters is accuracy, speed, and a layout that makes large tables easy to read on both desktop and tablet. A lightweight tech stack such as React or Vue on the front end and a simple Node, Django, or Laravel back end is fine, as long as the code is well-commented and easy for another developer to extend.

Deliverables
• Fully-functional site hosted on my chosen server  
• Secure connections to the three data sources mentioned above  
• Table generation module with export options  
• Brief setup/read-me so I can replicate the environment locally  

I’ll test by loading sample data from each source and confirming the tables match the raw records. Once that passes, the project is complete.

title: AI360central.com AdSense Approval
desc:
I’ve just launched AI360central.com and, apart from a few placeholder pages, the site is still lean on content. The long-term goal is to fill it with e-commerce products, but first I want the domain accepted into Google AdSense so revenue can begin flowing while the catalogue grows.  

What I need is end-to-end assistance that takes the site from “new and almost empty” to “fully compliant and approved” in Google’s eyes. That includes advising on — and, where required, directly implementing — the policy-critical pages (Privacy, About, Contact, Terms), tuning the layout for faster Core Web Vitals scores, connecting Search Console and Analytics, and guiding me on just enough high-quality product or supporting content to satisfy AdSense’s minimum thresholds.  

Deliverables (all must be met for final sign-off):  
• Approved AdSense account with AI360central.com successfully added and ads serving.  
• Compliance pages live and linked in both the header and footer.  
• Proof of submission and acceptance emails from Google.  
• A brief hand-over document outlining any maintenance steps or best practices I should follow.  

If you’ve secured AdSense for new, low-content e-commerce sites before and know the exact hoops to jump through, let’s get started right away.

title: BMS & Thermal Prototype Engineer
desc:
I’m moving from concept to bench-top reality on a new battery pack and I need an R&D hardware engineer who is equally comfortable with Battery Management Systems like Anker 737 & thermal control hardware. I’m looking someone with a hands-on specialist who can own the phase, turning those drawings into a working assembly that can survive abuse testing and provide clean, reliable data.

Your day-to-day focus will be:

• Circuit design for the BMS daughter-boards, including cell-balancing, current-sense, protection FETs and all supporting analog/digital interfaces.  
• Thermal analysis of the pack and its integrated cold-plate, using your calculations to specify sensors, heaters, interface materials and control loops before committing them to hardware.

Once the schematics and thermal stack-up are frozen, you’ll drive the board spins, source parts, assemble the prototypes and bring them up in the lab. I already have a small test rig with programmable loads and an environmental chamber; you’ll script the characterisation runs, capture the data and recommend the next round of tweaks.

Acceptance criteria
– Functional BMS prototype that communicates over CAN and handles balancing / protection within spec  
– Thermal subsystem demonstrating ≤ 3 °C cell-to-cell delta at 2 C discharge in a 35 °C ambient chamber test  
– Full documentation set: schematics, BOM, Gerbers, thermal model and test report
Note:  few more modules & deliverables which I will explain over the chat. BMS & therma

title: Nigeria Incense Market Research
desc:
I want to understand how Nigerians choose, buy, and use incense sticks so I can position a new product line effectively. The work centres on two angles:

• Consumer preferences & buying behaviour – demographic profiles, purchase triggers, fragrance and brand loyalties, price sensitivity, occasions of use, preferred retail channels (open markets, supermarkets, online, kiosks), and any cultural or religious influences that shape demand.  
• Key drivers and challenges – economic factors, supply-chain realities, import duties versus local production costs, distribution hurdles, regulatory considerations, and emerging lifestyle trends that either push or hinder category growth.

Please compile the findings into a concise report (Word or PDF) plus an Excel sheet summarising any quantitative data. Cite every source so I can trace statistics or quotes back to their origin. Up-to-date information (2022-2024) and Nigeria-specific insights are essential; regional or global data is helpful only when it directly informs the local picture. If you already have access to reputable consumer panels, trade journals, or field contacts, let me know—speed and credibility matter more than sheer page count.

title: Las Palmas Employment Background Check
desc:
I need a concise employment background check completed for a candidate based in Las Palmas. The scope is limited to confirming the individual’s employment history with one previous employer—no criminal or education records are required.  

Please contact the stated employer, verify the exact dates of service, job title, and whether the candidate left in good standing. A short written summary in English (PDF or Word) that includes the verifier’s name, position, contact details, and the method you used to confirm the data will be enough.

Deliverables  
• Written verification report for the single employer  
• Any email or letter of confirmation obtained  
• Timestamp of the verification call or correspondence  

I will review the documentation within 24 hours of submission; payment is released once the dates, role and reason for departure match the details I provide privately.

title: ProductMaster.app User Acquisition
desc:
I’ve built ProductMaster.app and now need a results-driven marketer who can turn it into a living, breathing community of real users. Your mandate is very clear: bring in people who will genuinely sign up, return, and eventually pay for the service.

Here is what success looks like for me:  
• You quickly grasp the core value of the platform so you can speak to prospects in their own language.  
• You define, validate, and refine the ideal audience segments instead of guessing.  
• You run rapid-fire experiments across paid and organic channels, double-down on what converts, and shut down what doesn’t.  
• You install or integrate tracking (GA4, Mixpanel, or your preferred stack) so we know—without ambiguity—how many visitors, sign-ups, and upgrades each tactic generates.  
• You keep me in the loop with concise weekly reports that translate data into next steps.

I’m not interested in vanity metrics or generic social posts. If your strength is real user acquisition and you have case studies or numbers to prove it, I want to hear your game plan for getting our first wave of active, paying customers.

When you respond, briefly outline:  
1. A channel mix you’d test first and why.  
2. The analytic tools you’ll rely on.  
3. A ballpark timeline for hitting the first meaningful milestone (e.g., X activated users).

Looking forward to collaborating with someone who thrives on measurable growth.

title: Portable Event Steel Column Design - for smart lockers
desc:
I need a steel column engineered for a commercial-grade outdoor events setup. The piece must stand independently, break down quickly for transport, and reconnect on-site with minimal tooling. Wind loads, repeated assembly cycles, and safe crowd interaction are the core considerations, so the design has to balance strength with portability.

I will supply overall height, base footprint, and maximum live-load data the moment we start; everything else—from member sizing to connection details—comes from your structural know-how. A clean 3 D model is essential because the column will interface with prefabricated truss sections already in STEP format. If you prefer SolidWorks, Inventor, Tekla, or a similar platform, that’s fine as long as the native file exports cleanly to .STEP without feature loss.

Here’s how I plan to sign off the work:  
• 2-D fabrication sketches (PDF + DWG) showing every plate, bolt, and weld symbol  
• A single, watertight .STEP assembly ready for CNC/laser quotation  
• A brief calculation note or FEA screenshot confirming the column’s capacity against the stated loads and safety factor

Once those three items pass a quick clash-check with my existing truss model, the project is complete and final payment releases immediately. If you can simplify hardware or suggest a smarter splice, I welcome it—every kilogram saved reduces freight costs. I’m ready to begin as soon as you confirm the timeline and tool set you’ll use.

title: ECU Design Specialist Needed
desc:
I need an experienced professional to assist with the design and development of an Engine Control Unit (ECU). 

Key requirements include:
- Hardware Design: Create robust and efficient hardware architecture.
- Firmware Development: Develop reliable and high-performing firmware.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Expertise in embedded systems
- Proficiency in hardware design tools (e.g., Altium, Eagle)
- Strong firmware development skills (C/C++, RTOS)
- Experience with ECUs and automotive standards (e.g., ISO 26262)
- Integration and system testing experience

If you have a proven track record in ECU design and development, please submit your proposal.

title: Minimalist Three-Floor Bungalow Design
desc:
I’m ready to move from ideas to precise plans for a modern three-storey bungalow with a clean, minimalist aesthetic. Each floor should feel airy and uncluttered, with generous glazing—large floor-to-ceiling windows are a must—to flood the interior with natural light and visually connect the house to its surroundings.

For the exterior, I’m leaning toward a predominantly glass envelope. Think transparent façades, subtle framing, and seamless transitions between indoors and outdoors. If you believe selective use of complementary materials will enhance structure or energy performance, I’m open to hearing suggestions, but glass should remain the star feature.

Key expectations  
• Concept sketches that capture the minimalist look and stacked-floor layout  
• Detailed architectural drawings (plans, elevations, sections) suitable for local permitting  
• 3D visualisations/renders illustrating daytime and evening lighting through the extensive glazing  
• A brief material and finishes palette, highlighting how glass will be integrated for both aesthetics and thermal efficiency  
• Basic structural and MEP guidance so any engineer can pick up the package without guesswork

If you excel at minimalist residential design and can articulate ideas clearly through drawings and renders, I’d love to see your approach.

title: Zapier Workflow Automation Expert Needed
desc:
I want to replace the manual busy-work in my current processes with clean, dependable automations built in Zapier and organised in Notion. The priority is to remove repetitive data entry, push real-time notifications, and handle file moves or uploads automatically while also preparing the flow for future payment-related triggers.

Current stack  
• Google Sheets holds most of the raw data  
• Slack is our day-to-day communication channel  
• Trello tracks tasks and status  
• Notion is where I document the entire system  

Scope of work  
1. Map the existing steps for data capture, updates, alerts, file transfers and eventual payment events.  
2. Create Zaps that sync Google Sheets ↔ Notion, post conditional alerts to Slack, move or rename files as needed, and update Trello cards without human input.  
3. Set clear naming conventions, filters and error-handling so each automation can be audited quickly.  
4. Document every Zap in Notion with screenshots, links and a short “how it works” note.  

Acceptance criteria  
• All data updates reflect in Sheets, Notion and Trello within a minute of the trigger.  
• Slack messages fire only on the defined conditions—no noise.

• No Zapier task overruns in the first week of live testing.

title: Equipment Finance Investor Pitch Deck
desc:
I need an institutional-grade investor presentation that will anchor a Regulation D 506(c) raise for my U.S.–based equipment financing and leasing platform. Our strategy is pure asset-backed finance, placing income-producing assets—primarily construction and mining equipment—into lease or finance contracts that generate predictable cash flow and attractive depreciation benefits.  

The final deck must convince sophisticated, accredited investors by laying out four things with absolute clarity:  
• our business model and market positioning  
• the detailed transaction structure of each lease/loan pool  
• five-year financial projections with key metrics and downside cases  
• the tax-advantaged depreciation profile that boosts after-tax yield  

I will supply the underlying assumptions, term sheets, and model outputs once we agree on scope. From you I expect a polished, data-driven slide narrative (PowerPoint or comparable editable format) plus any supporting graphics or appendices that reinforce due-diligence readiness. Institutional tone, coherent flow, and clean visual hierarchy are mandatory acceptance criteria.

title: Handwritten Document Data Entry
desc:
I have a collection of printed pages filled out entirely by hand. I will scan them and share clear, high-resolution images; your task is to key everything into a digital file with absolute accuracy. The handwritten material is the only source, so careful reading, consistent spelling, and faithful reproduction of every word and number matter.

You are free to work in Excel, Google Sheets, or Word—whichever lets you keep the original order of the entries and makes it easy for me to review. Anything you cannot decipher should be highlighted or commented so I can confirm the wording later.

Deliverables
• A neatly formatted digital file containing all entries in the same sequence as the originals  
• A brief log of any illegible items you flag

Once complete, I will spot-check against the scans; a 99 % or better accuracy rate is expected before final approval. Let me know your experience with handwritten transcription and how quickly you can turn around the first batch.

title: Object Detection Model for Disease
desc:
I'm seeking an expert in deep learning and computer vision. You'll work with publicly available datasets to develop an object detection model targeting disease.

Key Requirements:
- Expertise in PyTorch and Transformers
- Proficiency in XAI (Explainable AI)
- Strong background in computer vision

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience in building object detection models

Looking forward to your bids!

title: Handwritten Notes Typing
desc:
I have a collection of handwritten notes that need to be converted into clean, editable text. The job is straightforward—type each page exactly as written, keeping spelling and punctuation true to the original, but with no extra styling beyond plain paragraphs. Headings, bullet points, or custom layouts are not required; standard text is all I need.

You’ll receive high-resolution scans of the handwritten pages. Simply transcribe them into a Word document (or Google Docs if you prefer) and return the files, one document per source bundle.

Accuracy is paramount, so please proofread your work before submission. If any portion of the handwriting is unclear, flag it for me with a brief note so I can clarify. A quick turnaround is appreciated, and I’m happy to answer questions along the way to keep the process smooth.

title: Convert PDF to Word
desc:
I have a PDF that contains text only—no images, tables, or bullet lists. Your task is to transfer everything into an editable .docx file, keeping the original font styles and basic layout intact. No additional formatting, design, or re-typing shortcuts; I need the Word document to mirror the PDF’s look while remaining fully editable.

The final deliverable is a clean, correctly formatted Word file with all text preserved exactly as it appears in the source PDF.

title: Pre-Employment vetting project, Bogota - Colombia
desc:
I need reliable, on–the-ground assistance in Bogotá to verify a candidate’s employment history as part of my pre-employment vetting process. The task is limited to employment verification only—no background, reference, or drug checks are required.

Here’s what I’m looking for:

• Confirm the individual’s job title(s), department or role, and start/end dates.  
• Collect the verifier’s name, position, and preferred contact details for audit purposes.  
• Supply a concise written report (PDF or Word) in English, including your verification notes, date/time of calls or emails, and any supporting screenshots or signed letters you obtain.

All communication with the employer must comply with Colombian employment-law norms and company privacy policies. The final report will be deemed complete when the above points are documented clearly and verifiably.

– Central REST/GraphQL API, secure authentication (JWT/OAuth), and an admin console where I can configure features, pricing plans, and white-label branding.

3. Mobile binaries ready for store submission.

title: AutoCAD Mechanical Part Design
desc:
I need a moderate-complexity mechanical part drafted accurately in AutoCAD. The scope is limited to a single part design, not an entire assembly, but it must include every critical detail: full dimensional annotation, tolerances, material call-outs, and neatly organised layers ready for downstream manufacturing.

My rough sketch and key measurements will be supplied at kickoff. From there, I expect a clean DWG (and optional PDF) that conforms to standard mechanical drawing conventions. A 3-stage milestone structure works best for me—initial layout, first revision, and final file—within a total project budget of $1,000.

Completion will be accepted when the final DWG opens without errors, dimensions match the provided spec within ±0.1 mm, and line types, layers, and title block follow the agreed template. If you routinely work in AutoCAD for mechanical drawing and are comfortable with mid-level part complexity, this should be a straightforward engagement.

title: SolidWorks Prototype Product Design
desc:

This is a product-design task, not just surface modeling, so I’m counting on you to think through basic ergonomics, assembly strategy, and manufacturability as you build the file.

I’ll provide hand sketches, reference photos, and key dimensions once we start. Feel free to suggest refinements that could simplify the build or improve function—I value collaborative input and quick check-ins when questions come up.

Deliverables:
• Native SolidWorks part and assembly files (.sldprt / .sldasm) with a clean, editable feature tree  
• STEP or IGES export suitable for 3D printing or CNC services  
• Short PDF drawing pack showing overall dimensions and critical tolerances  

Acceptance criteria:
• Opens in SolidWorks 2020+ with zero rebuild errors  
• Dimensions meet my specs within ±0.2 mm  
• Model is organized logically so later iterations are straightforward  

Individual has to work on my SolidWorks by connecting through the AnyDesk or Ultraviewer from their system. Task has to be performed remotely.

title: Vibrant Shopify Clothing Store
desc:
I need a full Shopify build for my new clothing label that captures the same bold, colourful energy you see on https://international.theupside.com/.  The site should open with strong lifestyle imagery, vivid colour blocks, and smooth, magazine-style scrolling that immediately showcases collections.

• Product zoom so shoppers can inspect fabric details on every PDP.  
• A defined colour palette applied consistently across all sections to keep the brand punchy yet cohesive.  
• Seamless payment-gateway integration (Shopify Payments plus any major cards and UPI) and a clear, tier-based shipping set-up ready for international dispatch.

For integrations, please hook the store to my chosen payment gateways and connect an email-marketing tool (Klaviyo or similar) so I can automate welcome flows and drop-cart reminders from day one.

Final hand-off should include a brief walkthrough video that shows me how to update products, adjust the lookbook slider, and launch campaigns.

If you’ve built visually striking fashion sites on Shopify 2.0 before, this will be a quick, satisfying collaboration.

title: End-to-End YouTube Production
desc:
I’m ready to hand over the complete production cycle for a new series of educational YouTube videos. Each piece will run 5–10 minutes and must convey information in a formal, highly professional tone while still feeling clear and engaging for viewers.

Here’s the flow I need you to manage:

— Research the topic I provide and craft a concise, audience-friendly script.  
— Record or generate a polished voice-over that matches the formal style.  
— Add accurate, well-timed captions and on-screen call-outs.  
— Design or source all visuals—whether motion graphics, stock footage, or screen captures—and edit them into a seamless final cut.  
— Deliver the finished video in 1080p (or higher) along with separate files for the script, captions, and audio.

I typically work in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Audition, but I’m open to your preferred tools as long as the end result looks broadcast-ready and can be tweaked if needed.

When you reply, please attach links to at least two educational videos you produced from start to finish, and walk me through your usual concept-to-final delivery process. Let me know your average turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video and any questions you have about the content or workflow.

If your style aligns with mine, we’ll move forward with a test project and then scale to a regular release schedule.

title: Web-based Digital Twin 3D Visualization
desc:
Hi Dear,

I’m looking for a web-based 3D Digital Twin / interactive 3D visualization POC for a cloud-based BMS platform.
